name: set_working_dir
description: Set the working directory recorded for the current AIOS process; only AIOS children spawned afterwards inherit it. It does not move the session's effective working directory, so relative paths in read_file/write_file/apply_patch/tree are unaffected — use `execute_command`'s `cwd` to run a command elsewhere.

dir.description: Absolute path to set as the working directory for the current process.
